notes: Cash-basis county, governmental funds only. Statement lines from Exhibit D Total Governmental Funds column (p4). Cash and fund balance kept separate: beginning/ending fund balance from Exhibit D; ending cash = Equity in Pooled Cash and Cash Equivalents (Balance Sheet p3), Designated Deposits 121,658 in ending_investments; beginning cash not printed. Balance sheet from the governmental funds Balance Sheet - Cash Basis (totals equal the Statement of Net Position 9,994,486). General Fund budget 'Taxes' 3,072,304 split into Property Taxes 2,804,172 and Motor Vehicle Tax 268,132 from the General Fund column of Exhibit D (adds exactly); General 'Local' and Road 'Local' kept as broad groups. Inheritance Tax 'Local' 266,214 is printed as Inheritance Tax on Exhibit D. Nonmajor funds recorded per fund column from the combining schedules (Schedules 2 and 4, pp9-12); the nonmajor budget schedules (Schedule 5, pp13-16) print only fund totals and are not recorded (no double counting). Veteran's Aid fund had no activity. The major Capital Outlay Highway Allocation fund (interest 18,374, public works 4,001,829, transfers out 17,874 on Exhibit D) has no schedule in the trimmed PDF, so it has no detail lines. Transfers: General -> Road 766,746; Road -> Highway Allocation Bond 504,090; Capital Outlay Highway Allocation -> General 17,874; E-911 -> Wireless 911 9,438 and Wireless 911 Holding 1,497; Ambulance -> Ambulance Sinking 55,000.
